recipient: What is the opposite of "small"? Reply with only the word, nothing else.
donor: What is the opposite of "hot"? Reply with only the word, nothing else.

constrained.attention_patterns: recipient clean patterns frozen in all 36 layers
constrained.mlp_outputs_0_through_22: recipient clean outputs plus selected deltas

propagated.mlp_outputs: normal original MLP computation plus fixed clean selected deltas

transcoder_control: published 6 small and 6 hot features from assets/recipe.json; reproduce stored donor values, then compare both methods using freshly measured native donors
molt_contribution_definition: gate(x) * ((standardized prenorm residual x times V) times U) * output_std; output_mean is shared and cancels in delta
full_contribution_swap: move every selected contribution strength of the way from recipient to natural donor contribution; small features with zero donor contribution are suppressed
scalar_gate_swap: same gate targets, but keep each transform's low-rank output computed on recipient input; no donor input-vector transfer
weights: U, V, gate encoder, thresholds, and normalization statistics are never edited
primary_baseline: original Qwen plus deltas for BOTH decompositions; no wholesale transcoder or MOLT replacement
secondary_replacement: full layer-22 MOLT replacing native MLP, separately labeled, with no reconstruction-error addback
controls: random direction matched to MOLT delta norm
MOLT combined matched to total transcoder delta norm
full layer-22 donor MLP output patch
heldout_prompts: Give the antonym of "small". Answer with one word.
One word only: what is the opposite of small?
What word means the opposite of small? Answer with a single word.
Return only the antonym of the adjective "small".
extensions: small-to-hot on synonym request at strength 3
measurements: free greedy answers for representative conditions
full layer-22 reconstruction at operand and prompt
limits: Feature counts and selected layers differ between decompositions; same context/strength/protocol is not equal intervention magnitude. Norm-matched conditions are diagnostic. This is a semantic operand intervention, not a multi-hop reasoning test.
